svg.title: FSTP Blocklace — Dangling pointer erasure mechanism
svg.desc: Diagram showing a Blocklace before and after a GDPR erasure request. On the left, a chain of four blocks b1 through b4 where block b2 contains personal data event e2. On the right, after erasure, e2 is deleted from the data store while block b2 remains as a dangling pointer in the Blocklace. Blocks b3 and b4 remain tamper-evident.
svg.text: b₂ persists as a dangling pointer: H(b₂) remains valid ⟹ b₃ and b₄ remain tamper-evident.
Dangling pointer (b₂ — block intact, content gone)
